4. If `<action>` is `on`, report what the command installed or repaired. If no installed skill folders were found or settings were skipped, surface that result and do not claim the hook will run. Otherwise note that the harness must load the updated settings (and satisfy any trust requirements) before it runs. On Hermes Agent, `on` cannot install or enable the plugin: if `impeccable context` reported `MANUAL_DETECTOR_REQUIRED`, report that the Hermes design-hook plugin is not provisioned. Installing or enabling it is a separate catalogue maintenance task; do not run an npm package or enable plugins from this flow.
